messages.content: Classify each expense line item into exactly one category from this list: airfare, alcohol, clothing, computer_accessory, food_beverage, gambling, gift, gift_card, ground_transport, health_otc, household_goods, jewelry, laundry_service, lodging, office_supplies, other, personal_care, personal_electronics, service_fee, software_subscription, tobacco. Classify what the item is, not the words in its name. Reply in json only, in this format: {"items": [{"line_id": "...", "category": "...", "reason": "one short sentence"}]}. Give category before reason.

response.content: {"items": [{"line_id": "S1", "category": "office_supplies", "reason": "Printer paper is an office supply."}, {"line_id": "S2", "category": "household_goods", "reason": "A mug is a household good."}]}
